newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Six die as two buses collide in central Russia.
newsitem.headline: Six die as two buses collide in central Russia.

text.p: At least six people were killed and four were wounded when two buses collided early on Wednesday near the central Russian city of Saratov, a spokesman for the Emergencies Ministry said.
He said the accident, involving a big city bus and a smaller passenger bus, was probably caused by an error by one of the drivers.
Extremely cold weather and snowstorms hit Russia this week, covering roads with a thick layer of icy snow.
